# dsh-opencode-go-router
English · 简体中文
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin that gives an OpenCode Go conversation using a DeepSeek-series
model a fresh routing id when the **next** request is predicted to miss the upstream prompt cache **
and** recent requests are slow. The prediction runs before the request is sent, so the switch applie
s to that very request and does not add a cache miss of its own.
It also keeps a two-tier pool of warm routing ids, so a new conversation with a similar prompt prefi
x can start on a backend that already has that prefix cached instead of paying a cold start.
This is the npm package for the DSH plugin whose internal id is `opencode-router`. It only rotates t
he OpenCode Go routing header; it is not a model adapter.
## Why
OpenCode Go pins a conversation to one upstream backend with the `x-opencode-session` request header
, and that backend serves most of a repeated prompt prefix from its cache. The cache is lost when th
e prefix changes: billion-context compaction rewrites the context, and a system-prompt change rewrit
es the prompt itself. After a rebuild the rebuild request is cold, but the request right after it is
warm again, because the rebuild just cached the new prefix on that backend.
So the only useful moment to move is *before* a request that is going to be cold anyway. This plugin
predicts the cache hit of every outgoing eligible request from the signals it has at that moment —
prefix changes, idle time, the last measured hit, and whether the last request just fully prefilled
a large prompt — and rotates the routing id when the prediction is at or below `cacheHitThresholdPct
` (25% by default) **and** recent requests are slow. Because the prediction is made in the `llm/stre
am` hook, before the request headers are assembled, the new routing id applies to the request that w
as predicted cold: the new backend builds the cache for that request, and no extra cold request is a
edicted cold: the new backend builds the cache for that request, and no extra cold request is added.
Only OpenCode Go DeepSeek-series conversations are eligible. Other models are never routed by this p
lugin, even when a route exists.
A system-prompt rewrite and a compacted message history are the two cases where the prefix certainly
changes, so a request carrying either is always predicted cold. A cold prediction alone never rotat
es: the recent requests must also be slow.
If consecutive switches still land on backends that miss the base targets, the plugin widens the nex
t trigger instead of repeating equivalent switches: each completed post-switch window that remains s
lower than `ttftThresholdMs` or `throughputThresholdTps` adds one step, giving the next decision `st
epTtftGraceMs` (2 s by default) more TTFT room and `stepThroughputGraceTps` (5 tok/s by default) les
s required throughput. A post-switch window that meets the base targets resets the step to zero. Fai
lure is always judged against the base targets, never the already-widened ones.
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
- **Measured cache evidence.** It wraps `llm/stream` for eligible requests and reads the final `usag
e` chunk. A request's cache-hit percentage is `cacheReadTokens / (inputTokens + cacheReadTokens)`; t
he fresh input plus the cached reads is the prompt the upstream billed. Samples keep TTFT, output to
kens/second, prompt tokens, cache reads, and the hit percentage, and the last `sampleSize` valid sam

ples per DSH session are used.
- **Fold ledger (diagnostics only, optional).** It also reads billion
-context's per-session state file (`sessions/openai/<host>_<sha256(conversationId).slice(0,24)>.json
`) and follows `metadata.cacheLedger.folds`. billion-context derives `conversationId` from the highe
st-priority conversation header, which in a DSH setup is `x-bili-plugin-conversation` (the DSH sessi
on id); `x-opencode-session` ranks below it, so rotating that header does not change the file. The l
atest fold is evidence that a large cold request was a rebuild; it no longer triggers a rotation by
itself. Nothing outside the plugin is modified: 0.5.0 removed the 0.4.0 pre-fold seam that had to pa

tch billion-context.
- **Eligibility.** Only requests from a configured provider (`opencode-go` by d
efault) whose model id starts with `deepseek` (case-insensitive) are considered. `models` can narrow
this to exact DeepSeek ids. Other models are ignored, and a rotation is skipped if the latest ordin
ary conversation request used a non-eligible model. Auxiliary requests that declare a `purpose` do n

ot change that state.
[该节后续省略]
## Warm routing-id pool
A routing id is tied to one upstream backend and its cache. When a conversation stops, its id can st
ill be useful to another conversation whose prefix overlaps. The pool exists for that handoff.
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements
- DSH with the `llm-pi-ai` adapter and an OpenCode Go provider (default `opencode-go`) configured wi

th at least one DeepSeek-series model (model id starts with `deepseek`).
- billion-context is option
al: when installed and actively saving session state, its fold ledger feeds the fold diagnostics. Wi
thout it the plugin still measures every request, keeps statistics, and logs pool swaps and cache hi

ts.
- DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer, below 0.3.0.
- Node.js 20 or newer.
## Install from npm

[该节后续省略]
## Install from a local checkout (development)

1. Keep this repository somewhere stable, for example `C:/Users/me/DSHs/opencode-router`.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and safety
- Stored data is limited to DSH session ids, generated routing ids, fold numbers, cache percentages,
TTFT, throughput, routing history, per-request cache-hit and pool-event logs, timestamps, and chunk
ed SHA-256 prefix hashes for pool matching. No prompts, messages, tool output, or API keys are store

d; the digest cannot be reversed into the prompt text.
- Every host callback catches its own errors.
A missing billion-context installation only switches the fold diagnostics off; a malformed state fi

le only produces a log entry.
- Rotating a header is a routing hint, not a guarantee that the gatewa
y picks a different physical backend. If the gateway ignores unknown or new session values, the plug

in cannot force a move.
- billion-context's state file is an internal format. If its layout changes,
the fold diagnostics may see no folds and stay idle; the plugin will not corrupt anything.
